phrasings: Adapt bounded listening and post-hearing operations to request-in, answer-out calls while delegating retained pause, disclosure, transcriber role and transcript cursor mechanisms to their source-first owners

capability_rows.capability: transcribe recordings with a time for every word, and redo the places where the speech model looped; hear a recording in the person's files, or a link's video, into words on their own computer; read transcript and caption files (srt, vtt, txt, json, YouTube json3) into timed words and check quotes against them
reach a person's own records from a tool run: the records door client every records tool uses
grant a tool to one context and record installs, pointing at the one definition instead of copying it
edit a recording's transcript: name a speaker or take the name back, split a passage before a chosen word, and write it as plain words to copy or export
cut word-timed transcripts, or untimed transcript text, into spoken moments and file each moment into topic buckets

keep categories of places (banking, health, social, shopping, adult content, entertainment) out of what a capture reads: which are on, whether an address is in one, the person's on or off, and more domains by cursor diff
tell a space owner, before they add a tool for members, what it would give each member, what it reaches or could cost, and whether the owner must decide it

listen to the microphone for a while: record it in pieces until an end time, hear each piece, name who said each turn from the prints people enrolled, and write each turn as a heard row as it is said; hear a recording another of the person's devices made the same way

keep what a list says true: set a list up for review with an owner, a review state and a check-again date per row, mark rows verified, outdated or asking to be checked, and list the rows nobody uses by use heat that halves with time
show the destinations an owner publishes
